title: DOE Genesis project

tellings.quote: And now the Department of Energy has this Genesis project which is sort of I think a way to collate and collect all the information from all of the national labs and run it through AI

plain: Michels says the Department of Energy now has something called the Genesis project, which he understands as a way to gather all the information from the national labs and run it through AI. He offers this himself, as his own reading, in an episode about a Secretary of Energy speaking on UFOs, which suggests he sees it as a possible way buried knowledge could surface.
